# Email sending

*Email a client from the Setup tab.*

Lets you email a client from the Setup tab without leaving the dashboard, and keeps a record of what was sent. Replies come to your normal inbox. Without it, the "Open in my email app" button still works.

**How long:** About 20 minutes, plus waiting for your domain to verify.  
**Cost:** Resend has a free tier that is plenty for this. Check their pricing page.

## What it turns on

- A Send email button on every setup step
- A record of what was sent and whether it arrived

## Without it

"Open in my email app" and "Copy" still work, so you can send it yourself.

## Steps

### 1. Create a Resend account

Resend is the service that sends the email for us.

[Open Resend](https://resend.com/signup)

### 2. Add your domain

In Resend open Domains and add wedgescale.com. Resend shows a few DNS records. Add them where your domain is managed (your registrar or DNS host), then press Verify.

This proves the email really comes from you, which keeps it out of spam. DNS changes can take a few minutes up to a day.

**Domain**

```
wedgescale.com
```

### 3. Make an API key

In Resend open API keys, create one with Sending access, and copy it. It starts with re_.

### 4. Give the settings to Supabase

In Supabase open Project Settings, then Edge Functions, then Secrets. Add these. EMAIL_REPLY_TO is optional and defaults to the from address.

**Names**

```
RESEND_API_KEY
EMAIL_FROM
EMAIL_REPLY_TO
```

**EMAIL_FROM is**

```
WedgeScale <contact@wedgescale.com>
```

**Or one command**

```
npx supabase secrets set RESEND_API_KEY=re_PASTE EMAIL_FROM="WedgeScale <contact@wedgescale.com>" EMAIL_REPLY_TO=contact@wedgescale.com
```

### 5. Put the functions online

Run these from your project folder.

**Commands**

```
npx supabase functions deploy send-client-email
npx supabase functions deploy integration-status
```

## How to know it works

- Create a test client with your own email address. On its Setup tab open a step, choose Email the client, and press Send email. It arrives from WedgeScale, and replying goes to your inbox.
- The sent email shows under "Already sent about this" with a green Sent label.
- If it fails, the label says Failed and shows why. The most common cause is a domain that has not finished verifying (dashboard.wedgescale.com is unaffected, the sending domain is).
